name: TC-SR-001 — 试拍上传页展示与图组坑位 [P0]
description: 验证IN_PRODUCTION状态下上传页展示：默认5个图组坑位、上传提示区、Excel导入区、底部操作栏
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const sampleTab = tabs.find(t => t.includes('试拍')); return { tabs, sampleTab: !!sampleTab }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const groups = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=group-card], [class*=sample-group]'); const addGroupBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('加一组')); const excelArea = text.includes('Excel') || text.includes('导入'); const draftBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存草稿')); const reviewBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('发起评审')); return { groupCount: groups.length, addGroupBtn: !!addGroupBtn, excelArea, draftBtn: !!draftBtn, reviewBtn: !!reviewBtn, reviewBtnDisabled: reviewBtn?.disabled }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为IN_PRODUCTION，当前用户是产运
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入试拍与评审tab
2. 验证默认5个图组坑位
3. 验证Excel导入区
4. 验证底部操作栏
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 默认展示5个图组坑位
2. 上传提示区展示最小集规则
3. Excel导入区展示下载模板和导入入口
4. 底部展示保存草稿和发起评审
5. 未达标时发起评审按钮置灰
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
